### This is a beta release

This build is for testing only. It is published as a pre-release, so it is not offered to
existing installations through the in-app updater — install it by hand from the assets below.

### Coming from the stable release

This line of betas changes how a computer identifies itself, which renames every host once.
Remove each host on both computers and pair them again with the same pairing password. If you
already installed an earlier beta, nothing further is needed.

### New

- A reset, in two scopes. Resetting the display setup clears shared displays, merged identities
  and input notes while leaving the pairing alone. Resetting everything returns to a fresh
  install. Both keep this computer's identity, so the other computer needs no clearing out, and
  both ask once before acting.
- This computer can be named. The name appears in the switch centre and the host switcher, syncs
  to paired hosts like any other host name, and starts as the name paired hosts discover this
  computer by — so both sides call it the same thing before anyone renames anything.

### Fixes

- Merging is only offered when one of your shared displays cannot be found, which is what an
  identity change actually looks like. It previously listed every other display present,
  inviting two genuinely different displays to be declared the same one.
- A display button now shows that it is working. These commands wait for the display scan and can
  take seconds, and a button that did nothing visible read as a missed click.
- "Add to shared" and "remove from shared" no longer look identical. The shared one is an outline
  button that turns red on hover, since removing also discards the input every paired host had
  for that display.

### Known limitations

- Undoing a merge leaves the inputs and notes that merging folded into the display the other
  identity joined.
- Merging and host names only sync between hosts running this version.
- The macOS DMG is ad-hoc signed but not notarized with an Apple Developer ID, so Gatekeeper may
  require manual approval.

### What to test

- Name this computer and confirm the switch centre, the host switcher and the settings field all
  agree, then clear the name and confirm it goes back to the machine name.
- Reset the display setup and confirm the pairing survives it.
- Watch a button while a switch or a shared-display change is running.
